# Make Markdown From Rich Text

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Makes markdown from the given rich text.

## Syntax

~~~~text
markdownFromRich(text: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
markdownFromRich(text: Rich Text)
~~~~
